**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 22:06
- [USER] User inquired about "Project Catalyst."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that Project Catalyst is an initiative by Apple to encourage developers to create innovative experiences on the iOS platform using new technologies and tools.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that Project Catalyst provides resources and support for developers to build new features and capabilities into their apps using Apple's latest technologies, such as ARKit, Core ML, and SiriKit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that the goal of Project Catalyst is to help developers create more powerful and engaging apps that take advantage of the unique capabilities of Apple devices.
- [USER] User requested to continue writing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described Project Catalyst as a platform that allows developers to easily port their iPad apps to Macs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that Project Catalyst allows developers to create one set of code that works on both iOS and macOS, saving time and effort.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that developers can use tools and frameworks like SwiftUI and UIKit to create Mac apps.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant highlighted that Project Catalyst includes design guidelines and best practices for apps that work well on both iOS and macOS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that Project Catalyst was announced at the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2019 and that many developers have adopted the technology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided examples of apps adapted using Project Catalyst, including Twitter, GoodNotes, and Jira.
- [USER] User asked about Project Catalyst by Cardano.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that Project Catalyst is also an initiative by the Cardano blockchain platform aimed at providing a decentralized funding mechanism for the development of the Cardano ecosystem.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described the funding mechanism as based on a treasury system where a portion of block rewards is set aside for community proposals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that Project Catalyst is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) that allows the Cardano community to propose and vote on funding proposals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that proposals can be submitted by anyone in the community and are evaluated and voted on by elected community representatives known as "treasury witnesses."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that funding is allocated based on the outcome of votes, aiming to support projects with a positive impact on the Cardano ecosystem.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described Project Catalyst as an on-chain governance system for the Cardano blockchain.
- [USER] User requested help to write proposals from Ghana to be submitted
